name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Israeli strikes on south Lebanon kill one on 4 Nov; US–Iran war fronts stay active
state: An Israeli drone strike killed a man in south Lebanon on 4 Nov, the first such death since September, Lebanon's health ministry said; Lebanon says Israel's war since March has killed more than 4,300 people (Arab News/AFP). The US–Iran war continues, with US strikes near Hormuz from 2 Nov (Washington Post) and tankers hit on 5 Nov. Several fronts are active at once.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, Lebanon and the Gulf, which advises against travel to several areas.
rubric_hit: Multi-front escalation: US–Iran war plus Israel–Lebanon strikes

sources.title: Arab News — Lebanon says Israeli strike kills one in south
Washington Post — US has conducted defensive strikes on Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz

why: Conflict involving Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen threatens civilians, shipping and wider escalation. Direct hostilities with Iran are tracked under Gulf / US–Iran war.
